title: User profile
description: A privacy-reviewed profile snapshot used to interpret the exported training data.

userId.description: The stable export subject identifier, pseudonymous in AI analysis exports.

displayName.description: The display name selected by the user.

registrationPlatform.description: The client platform on which the account was first created.

registrationMethod.description: The authentication method used when the account was first created.

acquisitionSource.description: The attributed acquisition channel captured when the account was first created.

timezone.description: The IANA timezone used for local dates and times.

loadSources.description: The ordered training-load source preference, encoded as a comma-separated list.

preferredSports.description: The preferred sport types, encoded as a comma-separated list.

altitudeOptimizationModel.description: The selected model used to account for altitude in performance estimates.

altitudeThresholdMeters.description: The altitude threshold in meters used by the selected optimization model.

defaultVdotSource.description: The preferred physiological source used to estimate VDOT.

vo2maxCorrectionFactor.description: The user-configured dimensionless correction factor applied to VO2 max estimates.

heartRateZoneModel.description: The selected model used to calculate heart-rate training zones.

paceZoneModel.description: The selected model used to calculate pace training zones.

powerZoneModel.description: The selected model used to calculate power training zones.

createdAt.description: The time the account was created in ISO 8601 format.

updatedAt.description: The time the account was last updated in ISO 8601 format.
